questions.q: What was Jerry, Black Beauty's new master, like?
choices: Kind, good, and merry
Strict and bad-tempered
Lazy and careless
Shy and quiet
questions.evidence: He was kind and good, and as strong for the right as John Manly

questions.q: What did Jerry like to do for fun while he worked?
choices: Make up little songs and sing them
Read the newspaper
Play cards with the other cabmen
Whistle for the birds
questions.evidence: He was very fond of making little songs, and singing them to himself

questions.q: How did Polly and Dolly help with the cab in the mornings?
choices: They brushed the cushions and rubbed the glass
They fed and watered the horses
They drove the cab to the stand
They counted the money
questions.evidence: to brush and beat the cushions, and rub the glass

questions.q: What is the message of Jerry's song about the morning?
choices: Time wasted early cannot be made up later
Mornings are the best time to rest
Hurrying always fixes being late
It is fine to sleep in on cold days
questions.evidence: You can't pick them up In the course of a day

questions.q: What made Jerry most nearly angry?
choices: People who were always late wanting the horse driven hard
Customers who did not tip
Rain on his clean cab
Other cabmen singing
questions.evidence: people, who were always late, wanting a cab horse to be driven hard, to make up for their idleness

questions.q: What did Jerry say when the two wild-looking young men offered a shilling extra to hurry?
choices: He would take them only at the regular pace
He would gallop all the way
He would take them for free
He would go only if they paid two shillings
questions.evidence: I will take you at the regular pace, gentlemen

questions.q: How did Larry treat his horse when he took the young men?
choices: He slashed his tired horse to make it go fast
He let it walk slowly
He gave it a rest first
He patted it gently
questions.evidence: slashing his jaded horse, he set off as hard as he could

questions.q: Why did the young man with the heavy portmanteau fall down?
choices: He stepped on a piece of orange peel
A cab knocked him over
He tripped over a dog
He slipped on ice
questions.evidence: trod on a piece of orange peel which lay on the pavement

questions.q: Black Beauty says, "I had a very good mouth." What does that mean in this chapter?
choices: He could be guided by the slightest touch of the rein
He could eat very quickly
He had very strong teeth
He never bit anyone
questions.evidence: I could be guided by the slightest touch of the rein

questions.q: Why did Jerry hardly ever need to use the whip on Jack?
choices: Jack understood his voice and the rein
Jerry had lost his whip
Jack was too old to go fast
The police did not allow whips
questions.evidence: I knew by his voice, and his click, click, when he wanted to get on fast

questions.q: What happened after the cab got stuck in a block at the bottom of Cheapside?
choices: The cart moved on and they raced to the station in time
The young man got out and walked
They missed the train
A policeman made them turn back
questions.evidence: we whirled into the station with many more, just as the great clock pointed to eight minutes to twelve o'clock

questions.q: Why did Jerry refuse the extra half-crown?
choices: Seeing how glad the man was to catch the train was pay enough
He thought the coin was fake
He was angry at the young man
The other cabmen told him not to take it
questions.evidence: 'twas quite pay enough for me to see how glad he was to catch that train

questions.q: According to Governor Gray, why would Larry die poor?
choices: He spent too much in whipcord
He gave all his money away
He never worked on Sundays
He drove too slowly
questions.evidence: you'll die poor; you spend too much in whipcord
